items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Her name is Theresa Mildred Edwards. She didn't play an instrument.

ctx.x: And he moved to Galveston...not Galveston, Beaumont, Texas. That was his base for a long time. And actually, I was 12 years old the first time I ever saw him. And I was already playing. I was playing in a band then. Yeah...
